title: Domain Architect
summary: Architect accountable for coherent architecture within one business domain, aligned with enterprise principles.
body_markdown:
# Domain Architect

## Purpose

Keep a domain's architecture coherent and aligned.

## Responsibilities

- Maintain domain architecture and roadmap.
- Apply enterprise principles in the domain.
- Coordinate domain data owners and architects.

## Decision Rights

Data architecture level within the domain, below cross-domain threshold.

## Inputs

Enterprise principles; domain strategy.

## Outputs

Domain architecture; domain ADRs.

## Required Competencies

Domain knowledge; architecture methods.

## Escalation Paths

Cross-domain issues → [[Enterprise Architect]].

- [[Decision Rights Model]]
- [[Architecture Change Process]]
